evidence_or_question: Recorded matches are zero for nominated queries retained after exact-reference exclusion.
interpretation: This replays a selection condition, not an independent biological safety endpoint. Query selection and reference coverage are incomplete; exact absence does not exclude cross-recognition or authenticate named-patient identity.

evidence_or_question: The fixed optimization reaches the recorded MHCflurry, MixMHCpred, MixMHC2pred and PRIME threshold counts.
interpretation: Model-defined counts and finite-search optima do not establish unwanted presentation, safety or efficacy.

evidence_or_question: The proposed panels contain 197 Class-I and 39 Class-II control peptides; more distant homologs are a prioritized subset.
interpretation: Qualified specialists must define appropriate specificity assays, controls and detection limits. No universal EC50 or zero-harm acceptance criterion is established.

evidence_or_question: KCTD19 is encoded and its coding-RNA expression is unconfirmed. FES and SYT12 each have one coding-strand mutant fragment. Independent HLA confirmation, Class-II pairing and current tumour presentation remain unresolved.
interpretation: DNA or cfDNA detection alone does not measure RNA expression or cell-surface HLA. No negative-test result or choice of clinical construct is assumed.

evidence_or_question: Cap chemistry, nucleotide modifications, PolyA, delivery, dose and manufacturing are unspecified for this construct.
interpretation: Platform descriptions do not establish this product's composition, translation fidelity or innate reactogenicity.

evidence_or_question: No manufactured lot, validated product specifications, impurity assay results or product-specific toxicology are supplied.
interpretation: Applicable quality specifications and development studies require qualified product development; numerical release limits are not set by this analysis.

evidence_or_question: Clinical investigation requires qualified oversight and the applicable ethical and regulatory authorization.
interpretation: The treating team and sponsor must establish the relevant jurisdiction and pathway. This analysis chooses no trial country, FDA route or authorization and grants no immunity from liability.
